messages:
zoe: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need to convert remediation items into runnable tests. Proposing a 7-day sprint. Owners needed for: regression promptset, replay load job, chaos drill + gating.

mike: I can take the regression promptset. Will pull failing prompts from traces, add to nightly evals, and include token-size histograms. ETA Wed EOD.

tara: Ill own the replay load job. Need infra for an ephemeral runner and a CI job. Will draft traffic profile Tue AM. Prefer sanitized replay; fallback to synthetic if PII blocks us.

ben: Ill own the chaos drill & runbook. Plan: staging 10% canary, explicit rollback checklist, and monitor verification. Dry-run next Thu.

infra-bot: Card created: "PMT -> tests sprint" assigned to zoe - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/314 (automated)

zoe: Gate proposal to codify: if KV-eviction > 0.1% OR model-fallback > 0.5% over 24h -> block rollout and page oncall. Please add gating checks to PRs.

mike: Acceptance criteria: replay P95 < 200ms and error rate < 0.5% on the replay window. Will include bad-case prompts + baseline.

tara: Infra reqs draft: ~30m sustained replay at 1500 VUs, 48h metrics retention. Ben, confirm any additional monitoring queries you need.

ben: Ack. Ill add explicit abort commands and the dashboard queries to the runbook. Also adding a safety timeout for the canary ramp.

zoe: Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30 for quick sync. Ill create cards, calendar invites, and set reminders. Update the board with PR links or blockers.
